verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Daytona serves an llms.txt at its root (HTTP 200, with an AI-oriented summary) and markdown versions of its docs pages (e.g. sandboxes.md). Daytona also publishes an agent skill bundling API, CLI and SDK references for agents. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and first-party documentation of the llms.txt coverage or an expanded llms-full variant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: An agent skill for creating and running sandboxes on the Daytona platform. Includes references and practical patterns for the Daytona API, CLI, Python, TypeScript, Go, and Ruby SDKs.
